methods.label: Use a right-triangle side ratio
methods.explanation:
A right triangle with a \(30^\circ\) angle gives a geometric way to find the sine. Let its hypotenuse have length \(h>0\). The side opposite \(30^\circ\) has length \(h/2\), so the definition of sine gives
\[
\sin30^\circ=\frac{h/2}{h}=\frac12.
\]
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 8 property of a right triangle with a 30-degree angle and the Grade 9 sine ratio definition.
